newsitem.title: USA: Indiana corn 23 percent harvested vs 48 average.
newsitem.headline: Indiana corn 23 percent harvested vs 48 average.

text.p: Indiana's corn harvest was 23 percent harvested as of Sunday, down from 48 percent average, and lodging was beginning to cause problems in some fields, the state's Agricultural Statistics Service said.
Soybeans were 54 percent harvested, against 84 percent average. Average moisture content was 13 percent, compared with 14 percent the previous week.
Average moisture content for corn stood at 25 percent, down from 27 percent the previous week.
Winter wheat seeding was 60 percent complete, down from 79 percent last year and 76 percent for the five-year average.
Rains on Thursday temporarily stalled harvest but there were 6.1 days suitable for fieldwork, the report said.
Topsoil moisture was rated one percent very short, 13 percent short, 81 percent adequate and five percent surplus.
Pasture and range condition was rated one percent excellent, 33 percent good, 51 percent fair, 13 percent poor and two percent very poor.
